Flatbed Towing in Calgary

Secure flatbed transport for cars, SUVs, and specialty vehicles—minimizing wear and preventing damage.

Call 587-914-0130
Request Service
What’s included

Safe, professional flatbed transport

We load and secure your vehicle properly, then deliver it to your preferred destination in Calgary and surrounding areas.

Accident & breakdown towing

Careful loading and transport when your vehicle can’t be driven.

All-wheel drive & low-clearance vehicles

Flatbed transport helps avoid drivetrain and bumper damage.

Long-distance or out-of-town tows

Reliable transport when you need to move a vehicle farther.

Dealership & shop drop-offs

We can tow to your chosen mechanic, dealership, or body shop.

Flatbed towing FAQs

Quick answers before you call.

When should I request a flatbed tow?

When the vehicle can’t roll safely, has drivetrain concerns (AWD), low clearance, or you want the most secure transport.

Can you tow from underground or tight parking areas?

Often, yes—tell us the location details and clearance so we can dispatch the right truck.

Do you tow after accidents?

Yes. We can recover and transport your vehicle to a shop, dealership, or other destination you choose.

How fast can you arrive?

Dispatch times vary by traffic and distance, but we prioritize urgent calls and provide an ETA when you contact us.

How do I request service?

Call 587-914-0130 or use our contact form.

Need a flatbed tow right now?

Fast dispatch in Calgary—call for an ETA and clear pricing.

Call Now

Towing & Roadside Services

Fast dispatch, safe transport, and reliable help whenever you need it.

Call Now
Request Service

Core Services

Professional towing and roadside assistance for drivers across Calgary and nearby communities.

Emergency Towing

Vehicle breakdowns can happen anytime. Whether your engine fails, your transmission gives out, or your vehicle becomes unsafe to drive, our emergency towing service in Calgary is available 24/7.

We dispatch quickly and transport your vehicle safely to:

  • your home
  • your mechanic
  • a repair shop
  • a dealership
  • or your preferred destination

Our goal is simple: get help to you fast.

Flatbed Towing

Need the safest way to transport your vehicle?

Our flatbed towing service in Calgary is ideal for:

  • luxury vehicles
  • lowered cars
  • all-wheel-drive vehicles
  • SUVs
  • motorcycles
  • accident-damaged vehicles

Flatbed towing minimizes wear and protects your vehicle during transport.

Roadside Assistance

Not every situation requires a tow truck. Sometimes you just need quick roadside help.

Our roadside assistance includes:

Battery Boost / Jump Start

Dead battery? We’ll arrive quickly and safely boost your vehicle.

Flat Tire Change

Got a flat? We’ll install your spare and get you moving again.

Fuel Delivery

Ran out of gas? We deliver fuel directly to your location.

Vehicle Lockout Service

Locked your keys inside? We can help you regain access safely.

Our roadside assistance team is available throughout Calgary—24/7.

Long Distance Towing

Need your vehicle moved outside Calgary?

We provide long-distance towing across Alberta, including:

  • Airdrie
  • Chestermere
  • Okotoks
  • Cochrane
  • Red Deer
  • Edmonton

Safe, secure, and affordable vehicle transport across the province.

  • 24/7 emergency dispatch
  • Fast arrival times across Calgary
  • Affordable rates starting at $75
  • Friendly, trained towing operators
  • Damage-free towing methods
  • Honest pricing—no hidden charges
  • Full roadside assistance services
  • Available day, night, weekends, and holidays

When you call Jim Towing, you’re calling a team that puts your safety and time first.
